thread:
alex: heads-up — seeing a pile of pending GPU jobs in us-west-2-prod. autoscaler isn't spinning up new nodes, pods keep failing to schedule with binpack errors. anyone else? :thinking:
ops-bot: [autoscaler] scale-up attempt blocked for nodepool-gpu-burst: reached max size (12) — initiating cooldown.
mira: I pulled scheduler logs, two recurring reasons: \`Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu\` and \`node(s) had taint that the pod didn't tolerate\`. But I also see nodes with free GPU capacity sitting in a different nodepool (gpu-large) that the pods don't match due to nodeSelector/taints.
sam: looks like a lot of batch jobs request fractional GPUs (0.25) in their helm chart. our device-plugin + runtime doesn't support fractional allocation on this node type (no MIG). so scheduler says 0/1 available despite GPU util being low.
joy: also noticed cluster-autoscaler had a scale-down 90s ago; CA refuses to scale up because of cloud-provider burst window and pending unready nodes limit. combined with nodeSelector mismatch -> chain reaction.
mira: snippet from failing pod: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                 From               Message
  ----     ------            ----                ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x12 over 5m)   default-scheduler  0/1 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 1 node(s) had taint {gpu: dedicated}: NoTolerations.
```
sam: short-term mitigation: enforce integer GPU requests for these batch jobs (change default from 0.25 -> 1) and add tolerations where appropriate. Long-term: either enable MIG on small-GPU SKUs or add a separate nodepool with MIG-capable instances.
alex: can we spin up a small mig-enabled nodepool as a hotfix? the current nodepool-gpu-burst is at cap.
joy: I can temporarily bump nodepool-gpu-burst max size in infra to 18 and flip CA expander to least-wasteful for this cluster. that should let CA allocate extra smaller nodes until we provision a proper pool.
mira: also tagging: we have a lot of pods using nodeAffinity to prefer gpu-large which excludes gpu-burst. that's a config drift thing from the older rollout. we should remove the strict affinity for batch jobs.
sam: opening PR to update charts:/diff -> set default.gpu.request: 1 and remove hard nodeAffinity for workloads/batch. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/1234 :hammer:
ops-bot: [deploy] autoscaler config rollback applied to cluster us-west-2-prod: nodepool-gpu-burst max=18.
alex: thanks. immediate triage plan: 1) accept PR to stop fractional requests for batch (sam) 2) deploy autoscaler bump (joy) 3) create new nodepool-mig-small (mira) 4) run a dry pack test to measure wasted GPUs (alex).
joy: note for postmortem: add a CA guardrail to alert when pods pending > 15m for GPU reason and when fractional-gpu-request percent > 30% in a namespace.
mira: I'll attach scheduler trace + problematic pod yamls to the incident ticket.
alex: nice — assign follow-ups in the ticket. everyone good with that plan? :thumbsup:
